copy135: Each LAND reign is ranked by settled reward credits divided by the protocol reference value of the controller’s own burned WORLD. It is not verified acquisition cost or a forecast.
copy137: Why did my Attack succeed without conquering LAND?
copy138: Every successful Attack burns the full amount. A takeover requires strictly more than the effective Resistance at execution. An equal amount only reduces Resistance to zero. expectedEpoch checks the reign; battles and decay within the same epoch can still change the result. Previews use the displayed chain snapshot.
copy139: How do Resistance and Treasury decay?
copy140: Resistance has a 45-day half-life; Treasury has a 60-day half-life. Battles apply decay to the old Resistance before adding or subtracting the new amount. The effect of earlier attacks also decays. Time alone never changes the ruler. Reads, settlement, withdrawal, and Profile edits do not reset the Resistance clock.
copy142: Settling a LAND credits its current ruler's claim before withdrawal. Settled claims remain withdrawable after losing LAND. Unclaimed treasure goes to the first ruler. Unreleased Treasury excludes released, unwithdrawn rewards.
copy144: The current Controller can edit the current epoch's Profile, even if none is valid yet. The protocol charges no fee, but writes cost Gas. Self-conquest, takeover, and reconquest start a new epoch and invalidate the old Profile. Third-party defense gives no share of LAND rewards or editing rights.
copy146: Any LAND can be attacked directly; map distance does not affect gameplay. Primary purchases require the exact BNB quote and mint the full WORLD amount. BNB donations are recognized on purchase or sync. WORLD sent to Core by mistake creates no purchase credit or sale inventory and cannot be recovered.
